name: FabStyle
source:
FabStyle is set in Harbor City, a fictional metropolis known as a bustling hub of the fashion industry. The protagonist is entrusted with her elder sister's apparel boutique, marking her first steps into the business world. As the store's new owner, she aspires to win the prestigious Platinum Trophy at the city-wide Business Awards—a crowning achievement in fashion management. While competing against sharp business rivals, she must balance her growing boutique with her college education and budding romance.

[From [url=https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/FabStyle#Plot]Koei Wiki[/url]]
translation:
《时尚达人》（FabStyle）以繁华的时尚产业中心——架空大都市“海港城”为舞台。主人公受托接管姐姐经营的服装精品店，由此迈出了踏入商界的第一步。作为新任店主，她立志夺得全市商业大奖中象征时尚经营最高荣耀的“白金奖杯”。在与精明强悍的商业对手激烈角逐的同时，她还必须在日益壮大的店铺经营、大学学业与萌芽的青涩恋情之间取得平衡。

[摘自[url=https://koei.fandom.com/wiki/FabStyle#Plot]Koei Wiki[/url]]
